fact: FAO trained Libyan national stakeholders in Tunis on 20-23 April 2026 in remote-sensing workflows for generating land cover maps on the MERWAT geospatial platform, which supports water use and agricultural infrastructure decisions in Libya.

OSS says experts from the Libyan Authority for Grain Production and the Agronomic Research Center of Misrata, which support the Ministry of Agriculture, trialled the GMES services MISBAR, GUETCROP and SAQIYA on their own plots and plan to adopt them for larger areas.

fact: The Sahara and Sahel Observatory states that it trained the Libyan Agricultural Research Center, which supports the Agriculture Ministry in monitoring campaigns, on 26 February to 1 March 2024 in using the MISBAR, MISLAND and GUETCROP Earth Observation tools, with a roadmap for Libyan use cases to follow.
